name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Lifecycle Marketing | Onboarding, Activation, Nurture & Retention Journeys | Marketing Automation, Salesforce, AI Workflows
summary: Lifecycle marketer with 15+ years in B2B SaaS, MarTech, and agency roles, spanning both sides of the customer journey: the automated programs that move people from lead to activation, and the hands-on onboarding and retention work that shows what actually drives adoption. Builds segmented, behavior-triggered journeys across capture, qualification, onboarding, nurture, reactivation, and expansion, with lead scoring, lifecycle stages, and email and SMS deliverability above 99%. Ran a free-audit offer as a product-led entry point (180+ businesses enrolled) alongside sales-assisted motions, onboarded 25+ SaaS clients a month at Wix, and retained ~94% of a partner book at Birdeye. Works in Salesforce, HubSpot, and GoHighLevel, and builds AI-powered personalization into production workflows.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Architected a 20+ workflow lifecycle system spanning lead capture, tagging, and routing, qualification, booking with confirmations and reminders, no-show recovery, post-sale onboarding nurture, long-term nurture and reactivation, and review generation.
Built lead scoring, qualification criteria, and lifecycle stage definitions, and segment journeys by behavior, stage, and intent across email and SMS.

Launched a free digital-footprint audit as a product-led entry point, promoted through organic LinkedIn growth: 180+ businesses enrolled, with an automated workflow scoring each one and triggering personalized follow-up (2 converted to paying clients).
Build AI-powered personalization into production workflows, calling LLM APIs to generate tailored outreach from each contact's data, and run evaluation loops to catch underperforming logic.
Set up sending domains, SPF/DKIM/DMARC authentication, and warm-up, holding deliverability above 99%.
Track lifecycle and campaign performance in GA4, CRM analytics, and dashboards covering funnel progression, conversion, and ROI, and iterate on the results.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Produced multi-touch email sequences, landing pages, and conversion copy for B2B clients, improving lead generation and pipeline.
Ran ABM-style LinkedIn campaigns for small, researched account lists with A/B-tested setups, and reported ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs in QBRs.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Built automated product-training and communication sequences that reduced onboarding friction and sped adoption across a 15-20 partner network.
Analyzed partner utilization in Salesforce to find adoption gaps and trigger interventions that reduced churn, retaining all but one partner (~94%).
Advised partners on retention strategy, customer health metrics, and automated workflows to communicate product value to their own customers.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Analyzed campaign performance data at a performance marketing agency and translated results into optimization recommendations across paid media and creative.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ SaaS clients per month at 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets, driving users to their first live milestone.
Drove a 25% improvement in conversion rates across supported accounts through proactive, well-timed communication on client goals.
Advised on A/B testing strategy for a Salesforce workflow-automation effort, defining test structure and success criteria.
Led onboarding teams of up to 30 specialists for a new vertical that grew from proof of concept to a profitable business line.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Helped leadership build the lead qualification system, and built Zapier automations for clients.
Ranked top three of 8 to 15 reps for most of a 27-month tenure while quota roughly doubled.
